title: The cotype-cotype conjecture with the approximation property
exact_target: For every nonzero real Banach space X with the ordinary approximation property, is X K-convex if and only if both X and its continuous dual have finite cotype, allowing different finite exponents for the two spaces?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
